This single-family residence in Los Gatos, CA, priced at $1300per month, features 3 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms across 1,644 sqft. The home boasts a spacious open floor plan, wood flooring, upgraded central air conditioning, and a well-equipped laundry room. It includes a large private backyard, ideal for gardening, and is conveniently located near the Los Gatos Creek Trail and central amenities. An attached two-car garage provides ample storage. Make this modern 2bd in Cow Hollow your next residence. Features include:
- Open floor plan living, dining & kitchen layout.
- Beautiful wood floors, crown moldings & high ceilings.
- Modern kitchen with granite counters, stainless steel appliances and gas cooking.
- Off the living room is a private balcony with views.
- Primary bedroom with walk-in closet and attached bath.
- Large 2nd bedroom.
- Baths feature designer fixtures and finishes.
- Washer and Dryer in unit for your convenience.
- 1 car parking included.
- Shared roof deck with City, Bay and Golden Gate views.
- Located in a 10-unit building.
- Numerous shopping and dining options right outside your door on Union Street and nearby Polk Street.
- Convenient to Golden Gate Bridge and Hwy 101.
- Transit options include multiple MUNI lines.
KEY TERMS:
- Security Deposit = 1.5 x Rent.
- Pets not allowed.
- Available now.
- Min. 1 yr lease term.
- Water & garbage included.
- Unit will be delivered unfurnished. Furniture shown is for staging purposes only.
- Condo HOA Move-in Move-out Fees (paid by Tenant): $150 fee + $1,000 deposit (each move). Intercom change fee of $100.

3BR/2.5BA Inner Richmond Single Family Home on a quiet tree lined street. Close to the best pocket of GG Park, Rossi Park, Balboa and Clement street restaurants and shopping. Sunroom with level walkout deck that overlooks deep backyard with mature trees. 3000ft lot. Front yard. Above grade garage. Expansion potential. Office on garage level. 2 car garage parking + driveway. Built in 1921. Period details = Oak wood floors, fireplace, coved ceilings. Laundry in garage. Skylights in kitchen and sunroom.

Available Sep 13, 3 bed 2 bath on Polk St in Russian Hill. $7400/month, $7400 deposit.
Garage parking at $200/month, worth knowing upfront that the entry has a limited width, so you'll want a vehicle with a solid turning radius. Shared laundry is in the building. Those 2 things sorted, here's the rest: this is a fully remodeled flat, taken back to the studs, and it shows. Quartz counters, all new appliances including a gas range, microwave, dishwasher, and disposal. The kitchen has a big dining window and real room to use the space. 2 of the rooms have original decorative fireplaces and period coved ceilings with trim that you don't find in newer buildings. 2 built-in closets, 2 separate entries, a storage cove with a door, and about 1300 sqft total. The 3rd bedroom works with a landlord-provided armoire.
Water, trash, and sewer covered. Gas and electric on the tenant (PG&E).
Polk and Union is a Walk Score 100 block.
Pets considered case by case, 25 lb weight limit, breed restrictions apply, $250 deposit per pet and $30/month per pet.
1yr lease, longer term preferred.
Come see it Wednesday September 2 starting at 5pm through 7, Saturday September 5 from 11-2pm, or Saturday September 12 from 2-4pm.

Rarely available and on the rental market for the first time in 40 years - a fully remodeled top-floor Victorian apartment in the heart of the Mission District. Approximately 1,400 sq ft, blending original 1910 character with a complete 2026 renovation.
THE HOME
- 3 spacious bedrooms
- Full bath plus a separate toilet room
- Two grand formal rooms (living and dining), each with an original Victorian fireplace, bay windows, and built-in china cabinets
- Restored original oak and parquet floors, high ceilings, wainscoting and crown molding
- Remodeled kitchen: quartz-style counters and backsplash, stainless refrigerator, gas range, generous cabinetry
- Updated bath: marble-style tile, glass-enclosed shower, modern black fixtures
- In-unit laundry, central heat and A/C, smart doorbell
- Shared greenhouse bonus space
- Sweeping downtown San Francisco skyline views from the top floor
TERMS
Rent: $7,350/month
Security deposit: $7,350
Lease: 12 months minimum, longer terms available
Available: immediately
Included in rent: water and trash
Tenant pays: PG&E (gas and electric), internet, cable
Parking: street parking only
Smoking: not permitted
Pets: considered, $250 pet deposit
Located steps from the restaurants and shops along 22nd Street, with convenient access to transit.
Full photo gallery and details: missionvictorian.com

Family home available for sublet in sunny Bernal Heights while we are travelling. We are seeking subletters who will enjoy our home and take care of it. Perfect for families, individuals, and couples of all ages. Our house is filled with character, with expansive views of downtown and the city, and would be most enjoyed by artistic individuals who appreciate creative architecture. The main floor includes a beautiful kitchen and living room, multiple bedrooms, a bathroom, and office space. The downstairs levels include additional sleeping areas, bathrooms, and a spacious family room. We are located on a flat street with a wide sidewalk, accessible on foot to all amenities.
